"""
    get_num_eigenstates(vf::VelocityField) -> Int

Get the number of eigenstates in the amplitudes data.

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: The velocity field object

# Returns
- `Int`: The number of eigenstates
"""
function get_num_eigenstates(vf::VelocityField)
    get!(NUM_EIGENSTATES, vf.file_paths[AMPLITUDES_FILE]) do
        h5open(vf.file_paths[AMPLITUDES_FILE], "r") do file
            vel_data = read(file["vel_data"])
            # In Julia, the dimensions are preserved as they are in the file
            return size(vel_data, 2)
        end
    end
end

"""
    get_num_eigenstates(vf::VelocityField) -> Int

Get the number of eigenstates in the amplitudes data.

# Arguments
- `vf::VelocityField`: The velocity field object

# Returns
- `Int`: The number of eigenstates
"""
function get_num_eigenstates(vf::VelocityField)
    return size(vf.amplitudes, 2)
end
